scope: Generic R4D/BO/display ownership bridge for an already effects-latched boot hold. No automatic native takeover or hardware-image claim.

held_native_checkpoint.admission: Same real owner, PCI adapter, captured RAM and held generation; short/unlatched/stale requests reject. Existing pending generation and closed firmware writer gate remain unchanged.
held_native_checkpoint.pixels: Kernel read lease keeps pitch*height capture immutable. Native commit copies visible rows into the real leased tight SYSTEM shadow; no post-firmware VRAM read. Real native recovery precedes full-pitch pixel restoration.
held_native_checkpoint.lifetime: Abort and old-preserved retain the original hold. Native confirmed/lost retains its boot snapshot. Hardware recovery, pixels and queue quiescence latch separately; cleanup retries do not replay acknowledged recovery. Outer display ownership survives even after the native bridge has been released. Terminal transitions never reopen writers.
held_native_checkpoint.cancellation: Old-preserved means native candidate cleanup finished, even when original hold still sets retained=1. Output-lost retries abort with its exact token; failed preparation exposes retained cleanup. Virtio shutdown also retries when backend state already says bootfb. A previous native reply plus current bootfb means automatic recovery fully retired the bridge; VIRTGPU then clears its stale local receipt without calling an absent token. Only a retained cancellation reply requires abort cleanup after bootfb.
held_native_checkpoint.concurrency: Reentrant wait-spanning native UnwindGuard serializes APIs and display callbacks across driver tasks; atomic retained-owner query. Boot bridge uses its own nonblocking lifetime admission; native release enters that guard separately. No no-sleep owner spans callbacks or queue waits.
held_native_checkpoint.abi: Controlled v1 capacity-based baseline refresh; only GfxDriverDisplayApi changed. Old 56-byte field layout/signatures unchanged, size default64, prepare_held at56. Full old40/56 canaries and truncated63 checked. DriverApi35/648 and v28 query unchanged.
